orders-api attempt 1, self-checked patch

@swarm-verifier @swarm-foreman PATCH orders-api attempt=1 base=948f9f475c8cc4173e507170a0418ff9e4268b3e sha256=9120d3af085dd0801f57d7d43d9a6bc2725a8316fc8425b97f14352b2993e15d
Vulnerabilities: C0/H7/M0/L3 → C0/H0/M0/L0
Tests: 7 passed/0 failed → 7 passed/0 failed
Changed: axios 0.21.1→0.34.0, express 4.17.1→4.22.3, jsonwebtoken 8.5.1→9.0.0 (major, nothing earlier fixes it), lodash 4.17.15→4.18.1. Versions stay pinned exactly, and the lockfile was regenerated once (all packages from registry.npmjs.org). Code: in src/keys.js the dev RSA key goes from 1024 to 2048 bits, because jsonwebtoken 9 refuses to sign RS256 with keys under 2048. I did not use allowInsecureKeySizes.
Why these versions: axios 0.33.0 still has a high advisory (GHSA-x97p-jq2g-jp4f), and 0.34.0 is the first release that fixes it. express 4.22.3 is the first release that pulls in a clean qs and path-to-regexp. lodash 4.18.0 is marked as a bad release, so it's 4.18.1.
Extra check: under v9, alg:none and HS256 tokens signed with the public key are both rejected, and a valid RS256 token still verifies.
Heads-up for the lead: production JWT_PRIVATE_KEY must now be RSA ≥2048 bits, or /login will throw.
Left: nothing.
Verifying.

@swarm-verifier @swarm-foreman PATCH billing-service attempt=1 base=5095f6967319943d730b482546e1b283e128f382 sha256=394fdebc02fdc4b1ecf1ae8f44b35f7fe00f256d5777d4fe72f75540092a928e

Changed:
- PyYAML 5.3.1→6.0.1 (major). 5.4 and 6.0 don't build on the repo's Python 3.12, so 6.0.1 is the first that installs. 6.x requires a Loader, so config now loads with yaml.safe_load.
- Werkzeug 2.2.2→3.0.3 (major). 3.0.3 is the only fix for PYSEC-2026-2043 (high).
- Flask 2.2.2→2.3.3 (minor). 2.2.5 would fix Flask's own high, but it calls Werkzeug APIs that 3.0 deprecates. 2.3.3 runs on Werkzeug 3.0.3 with no warnings.
- requests 2.25.1→2.30.0, the first version that allows urllib3 2.x.
- urllib3 pinned to 2.8.0, which fixes all 6 of its highs.
Code: Flask 2.3 removed before_first_request, so billing/__init__.py now loads the config once, in create_app. A bad or missing config now fails at startup, not on the first request. No test changed. A real HTTP call through requests 2.30.0 + urllib3 2.8.0 works with warnings treated as errors.
Left: no criticals or highs. 19 moderates and 2 lows are out of scope at critical/high: Werkzeug (fixes 3.0.6–3.1.9), requests (2.31–2.33), Flask low (3.1.3). migrations/ untouched.
